#1
इदं|idam|idam — this (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with śarīram)
शरीरं|śarīram|śarīra — body (nom. sg. neut., subject)
कौन्तेय|kaunteya|Kaunteya — 'son of Kuntī', Arjuna (vocative)
क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते|kṣetram iti abhidhīyate|kṣetra — the field (nom. sg. neut., predicate);;iti — thus, that (quotation particle);;abhi-dhā — to call, name (abhidhīyate: present passive 3rd sg. 'is called'; kṣetram+iti simply written joined, -m unaffected before the vowel; iti+abhidhīyate → ity abhidhīyate, -i+a-→-y a-)
--
एतद्यो|etat yaḥ|etad — this (etat: nom./acc. sg. neut., referring to śarīram; -t+y-→-d y-);;yad — who (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative; -aḥ+v-→-o)
वेत्ति|vetti|vid — to know (vetti: present 3rd sg. 'knows')
तं|tam|tad — that, him (tam: acc. sg. masc., object of prāhuḥ)
प्राहुः|prāhuḥ|pra-ah — to declare, call (prāhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they call')
क्षेत्रज्ञ|kṣetrajñaḥ|kṣetra — the field (first compound member);;jña — knowing, knower (from jñā, second compound member; kṣetra-jña: 'the knower of the field', nom. sg. masc., a quoted predicate name kept in the nominative though logically the object of prāhuḥ, an iti-quotation idiom; visarga elided before the following vowel i-)
इति|iti|iti — thus (closing the quoted name)
तद्विदः|tad-vidaḥ|tad — that (first compound member);;vid — to know (vid-, 'knower', second compound member; tad-vidaḥ: 'the knowers of that [truth]', nom. pl. masc., subject of prāhuḥ)
#2
क्षेत्रज्ञं|kṣetra-jñam|kṣetra — the field (first compound member);;jña — knowing, knower (second compound member; kṣetra-jña: 'the knower of the field', acc. sg. masc., predicate complement of mām with viddhi: 'know me [as]…')
चापि|ca api|ca — and (ca+api→cāpi, a+a→ā);;api — also, even
मां|mām|aham — I (mām: acc. sg., object of viddhi)
विद्धि|viddhi|vid — to know (viddhi: imperative 2nd sg. 'know!')
सर्वक्षेत्रेषु|sarva-kṣetreṣu|sarva — all (first compound member);;kṣetra — the field (sarva-kṣetra: loc. pl. 'in all fields')
भारत|bhārata|Bhārata — descendant of Bharata, Arjuna (vocative)
--
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं|kṣetra-kṣetrajñayoḥ jñānam|kṣetra — the field (first compound member);;kṣetrajña — the knower of the field (kṣetra-kṣetrajñayoḥ: gen. dual 'of the field and its knower'; -oḥ+j-→-or j-);;jñāna — knowledge (nom. sg. neut., subject)
यत्तज्ज्ञानं|yat tat jñānam|yad — which (yat: nom. sg. neut. relative; simply written joined with the following tat, both ending in -t);;tad — that (tat: nom. sg. neut. correlative; -t+j-→-j j-);;jñāna — knowledge (nom. sg. neut., predicate)
मतं|matam|man — to think, hold to be (mata: past participle 'considered, held', nom. sg. neut.)
मम|mama|aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'by me, in my view')
#3
तत्क्षेत्रं|tat kṣetram|tad — that (tat: acc. sg. neut., anticipating the description to follow);;kṣetra — the field (acc. sg. neut., object of śṛṇu)
यच्च|yat ca|yad — which (yat: nom./acc. sg. neut. relative; -t+c-→-c c-);;ca — and
यादृक्च|yādṛk ca|yādṛś — of what kind, what sort (yādṛk: nom. sg. neut., the stem-final -ś appearing as -k word-finally);;ca — and
यद्विकारि|yat vikāri|yad — which, what (yat: nom./acc. sg. neut. relative; -t+v-→-d v-);;vikārin — possessing what modification, subject to what change (nom. sg. neut.)
यतश्च|yataḥ ca|yatas — from what, whence (yataḥ: ablative adverb; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and
यत्|yat|yad — what (nom. sg. neut. relative, 'and what [it is]')
--
स|sa|tad — he (sa: nom. sg. masc., referring to the knower of the field; the irregular sandhi form of saḥ before a following consonant)
च|ca|ca — and
यो|yaḥ|yad — who (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative; -aḥ+y-→-o)
यत्प्रभावश्च|yat-prabhāvaḥ ca|yad — what (first compound member);;prabhāva — power, might (yat-prabhāva: 'he whose power is what', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ+c-→-aś c-);;ca — and
तत्समासेन|tat samāsena|tad — that (tat: acc. sg. neut., object of śṛṇu, summing up the preceding description);;samāsa — a summary, compendium (samāsena: instr. sg. used adverbially, 'in brief')
मे|me|aham — I (me: enclitic gen. sg., 'from me' with śṛṇu)
शृणु|śṛṇu|śru — to hear (śṛṇu: imperative 2nd sg. 'hear!')
#4

'because of');;parama — supreme (first compound member; parama+ātmā→paramātmā, a+ā→ā);;ātman — self (parama-ātman: 'the supreme self', nom. sg. masc., subject);;idam — this (ayam: nom. sg. masc., agreeing with paramātmā; paramātmā+ayam→paramātmāyam, ā+a→ā);;a-vyaya — imperishable (nom. sg. masc., predicate; simply written joined, -m unaffected before the vowel)
